backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining Callaway scoring types, a static deduction chart, event submission/update logic, and result processing.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of many frontend files describing their roles in the app’s scoring, leaderboard, admin, and chart systems.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Developer documentation explaining the structure and update process for default 18‑hole and 9‑hole Callaway charts.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Notes indicating a restored draft session with no functional changes and describing the app’s current production feature set.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based style definitions providing OKLCH color variables, theming, and layout primitives for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell that loads the React application via main.tsx into the root element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring routes, scoring flow state, and transitions between setup, score entry, and leaderboard views.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component showing attribution, year, and a dynamic caffeine.ai referral link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component displaying the app title, step controls, start-over button, and navigation to settings and admin pages.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Shows admin page or a disabled-access message depending on admin setting, routing to settings when disabled.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: Provides UI to edit, validate, save, and reset 9- and 18‑hole Callaway scoring charts.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for entering tournament details with validation and passing the completed setup upward.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Displays a golfer’s gross, deduction, adjustment, net score, and hole-by-hole breakdown.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Renders the active Callaway scoring chart for the selected hole count using legacy-style entries.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Generates and opens a print‑optimized HTML window to export tournament standings as a PDF. Builds styled markup using event details and results.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Displays ranked tournament results with net, gross, deduction, and adjustment values and rank icons.
Computes Callaway results, renders standings, breakdowns, chart section, and supports exporting to PDF.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Renders a list of golfer score entry cards with editable names and per‑hole scores. Updates parent state and computes gross totals.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data, ensuring name, hole count, and each score are present and within acceptable numeric limits.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Displays application settings, including toggling admin access and a back button. Uses stored admin state and updates it through a switch.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity, recreating and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccessEnabled: Tracks admin access state reactively by listening for custom and storage events tied to localStorage changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching the latest event result and the Callaway chart using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a golf‑themed light/dark color palette, plus typography and utility overrides.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Implements Callaway handicap calculation, including chart lookup and deduction logic using backend or grid data.
Defines Callaway chart data structures and provides legacy 9- and 18‑hole charts with a lookup helper.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Handles loading, saving, and resetting editable Callaway charts and grid charts using localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/gridPlaceholde: Provides utilities for detecting and handling placeholder cells in grid-based Callaway charts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React application with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Manages admin-access state via localStorage and broadcasts changes via a custom event.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Declares TypeScript interfaces for event setup, golfer input data, and Callaway scoring results.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, plugins, colors, typography, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the project state, versioning, issues, and feature requirements for Callaway scoring.
